findings.where: h2 section heads vs h3 card titles
findings.evidence: Programmatic outline is correct (h1 > h2 > h3) but the h2s render smaller (18px vs 18.72px) and lighter (#6b7280 vs #111827) than their h3s. A sighted low-vision reader using magnification sees the card titles as the section heads.
findings.after: h2 { font-size: 1.75rem; color: #111827 } so visual and programmatic levels agree.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (advisory: visual structure should match the coded structure) and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels.
findings.title: Headings and landmarks
findings.fix: Fix levels in markup and size with CSS.

findings.evidence: Cards are fixed at about 448px and left-aligned; at 1440 roughly 70% of each row is empty while the section rules run the full 1360px width, so the rules frame nothing.
findings.after: Lay the cards in an auto-fit grid (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(20rem, 1fr))) or cap the whole document container at ~60rem so rule and content share a width.
findings.why: Dead band: the measure and the container were never decided together.
findings.title: No dead bands
findings.fix: Remove the empty band or fill it with content that earns the space.
